ABOUT VALERIAN

A focused approach.
A meaningful purpose.

Valerian is an American animal health company focused on veterinary products for companion and large animals. We bring a clear, practical perspective to animal care, connecting our product portfolio with the everyday needs of veterinary professionals.

Our range includes injectable presentations for anti-infective care, internal parasite management and supportive treatment. We believe that clear product information and a conversation with the right professional are essential parts of responsible care.

OUR PURPOSE

To support thoughtful veterinary care — for the animals that share our homes, work beside us and sustain our communities.

THE ANIMALS AT THE HEART OF OUR WORK

Different needs.
The same commitment.

From a much-loved companion to a working herd, good care starts by understanding the animal, its environment and its individual needs.

01

Companion animals

Dogs and cats need care that reflects their age, lifestyle and health history. Regular veterinary conversations bring preventive care, nutrition and wellbeing together in a plan tailored to the individual animal.

Explore care resources
02

Livestock & farm animals

Healthy herds rely on everyday observation, good husbandry and veterinary oversight. Product selection should reflect the species, the clinical situation and the official label, with clear treatment records and relevant food-safety requirements.

Our approach to care
03

Horses & equine care

A horse's routine, workload and environment all shape its care. We encourage a professional, species-specific approach to product enquiries, supported by the complete product leaflet and advice from the treating veterinarian.

General care context: AAHA preventive healthcare and FDA animal drug information. Product suitability is species- and label-specific.

A RESPONSIBLE APPROACH

Good care goes
beyond a product.

A veterinary product is one part of a wider care plan. We support informed conversations, clear information and the professional judgement that makes care individual.

01

Start with veterinary guidance

Diagnosis and product selection belong with the treating veterinarian. An animal's species, history and current condition all matter when deciding the appropriate next step.

02

Use clear product information

The official leaflet is the reference for composition, approved use, storage and precautions. Keep the original label available and ask when an instruction is unclear.

03

Support responsible medicine use

Antimicrobials require a considered veterinary approach. Treatment decisions should address animal health needs and follow the relevant professional guidance and local requirements.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Your questions,
answered.

A starting point for understanding the portfolio and making a useful product enquiry.

What does Valerian focus on?

Valerian focuses on veterinary products for companion and large animals. The current portfolio shown here comprises six injectable presentations across anti-infective, parasite and supportive care.

Is every product suitable for every animal?

No. Suitability depends on the individual product, approved species, local registration and the animal's needs. Request the official product leaflet and consult the treating veterinarian.

How can I request more product information?

Open a product and choose “Enquire about this product”. The product name will be selected automatically. Include your organisation and the information you need, such as the official leaflet or local availability.

Can I buy products on this website?

This website is a product information and enquiry destination. It does not offer online checkout. Product availability and commercial arrangements can be discussed with the official regional representative listed in the footer.

Where can I find dosage or administration instructions?

Use the official product leaflet and the instructions given by your veterinarian. Website summaries do not replace the complete prescribing information or professional advice.
